_comment: Scoped to make THIS directory CommonJS while proxy/ as a whole is ESM.
Node resolves module type from the NEAREST package.json, so without this
file handler.js would be parsed as ESM and `module.exports.handle` — the
shape Scaleway's Node runtime looks for — would throw at load time.
The shared core in ../src stays ESM and is reached by dynamic import(),
name: canamed-hf-patient-proxy-scaleway
